baseline_models.focus_anchor: The two occurrences of انقلبوا at words 2 and 5 lead through إلى أهلهم to the final state فكهين.
baseline_models.mechanism: A spatial return reaches a circle of belonging and culminates in delighted, sociable talk. The household is not incidental scenery: it is the audience that lets the returning mood become a shared performance.

activation_trace.role: Return and destination make both the movement away and its chosen endpoint active in the doubled verb.
Closeness and belonging identify the destination as an intimate group able to ratify a shared mood.
Delighted ease supplies the affective result of the return.
Congenial joking makes the resulting delight a household speech event rather than silent satisfaction.

changed_reading.after: They return to their own circle, where arrival becomes a mutually reinforced performance of pleasure and joking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same inflected verb is repeated on both sides of إلى أهلهم, allowing the second occurrence to do more than restate locomotion.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first turn can map the route home while the repeated turn maps a change of face or inward orientation inside familiar habitation. Social return and inward reversal coexist: the group receives them and turns the encountered scene into a settled disposition.

activation_trace.role: Turning from one face or state to another lets the repetition mark a second, qualitative turn.
The inward faculty supplies the possible interior destination of the second turn.
Familiar habitation supplies the low-friction enclosure in which an attitude can settle.
Banter is the observable form through which the inward turn becomes collective.

changed_reading.before: Both instances of انقلبوا merely describe one journey home.
changed_reading.after: The doubled turn can stage two movements at once: bodily return to the household and inward or social conversion of the episode into bantering delight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predicative فكهين names the manner or state of the second انقلبوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The terminal state can be boastful, wanton exultation rather than innocent good humor. The homeward destination gives that exultation a partisan audience, so the return reads as triumphal self-congratulation.

activation_trace.role: Insolent exultation darkens the apparently pleasant final state into swagger.
The close in-group supplies the audience before whom swagger becomes self-validating.
The destination branch makes exultation the carried result of their return.

changed_reading.after: Their return is triumphal: they carry an insolent sense of victory into the approving intimacy of home.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فكهين can activate both joking talk and the idiom of making sport of another's reputation, while أهلهم supplies the conversational circle.
baseline_models.mechanism: The absent encounter can be transported home as reputational material. The household does not merely hear a joke; its conversation consumes and redistributes another person's standing.

activation_trace.role: Making sport of reputations supplies a socially injurious object for the amusement.
Pleasant banter supplies the conversational vehicle for that reputational attack.
The bonded group supplies the network through which the absent target's standing is recirculated.

changed_reading.before: They exchange harmless jokes after returning.
changed_reading.after: They make the people left outside the house into the content of a reputation-consuming in-group conversation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening asymmetry of taking full measure for oneself while diminishing others migrates from goods to status. At home, the group awards itself a full measure of delight and superiority by measuring the mocked people down; laughter is the privately collected surplus of an unequal social valuation.

activation_trace.role: Swagger supplies the self-inflating gain produced by the group's private valuation.
Measuring one thing against another supplies the transferable comparison mechanism.
Balancing two parties supplies the social scale on which in-group worth is raised by lowering an outsider.
Induced shortfall specifies that the comparison is manipulated, not merely unfavorable.

structural_cues: 83:2-3 repeat the conditional frame while alternating self-favoring receipt and other-diminishing delivery; 83:31 repeats the conditional and doubles the return verb.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: measured exchange, comparison, and induced shortfall precede the focus. Reader arrow: their household pleasure is the social surplus extracted from another's diminished standing. Live alternative: commercial fraud and ridicule may be parallel instances of one ethic without the focus itself encoding measurement.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports a private aftereffect of mockery.
changed_reading.after: The homecoming completes a social short-measure: outsiders are diminished so the in-group can pay itself in swagger and amusement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Retelling at home joins the passing incident to a durable group account. Repeated banter patterns the event, enters it into communal identity, and converts a fleeting act into an acquired inward trace.

activation_trace.role: Banter is the medium by which the encountered scene is retold and stabilized.
The bonded household supplies a persistent community of memory.
Entry into a register supplies the transition from episode to attributed group record.
A visible repeated pattern supplies durability and recognizability to what the joking rehearses.
Acquisition supplies the process by which repeated performances become something the self carries.

structural_cues: The paired marked-book passages at 83:7-9 and 83:18-20 classify opposed groups, while 83:14 links an inward condition to what was repeatedly acquired.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: records, visible marking, acquisition, household, and banter coexist. Reader arrow: household retelling functions like informal inscription, joining an act to group identity and depositing it inwardly. Live alternative: the records may be divine records only, with no implied human recording process.

changed_reading.before: The jokes vanish when the evening conversation ends.
changed_reading.after: The household becomes a recording chamber where ridicule is rehearsed into memory, identity, and an enduring moral trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The inward turn of the baseline becomes a feedback enclosure. Familiar habitation lowers resistance to the joke; collective amusement helps the acquired coating settle on the inward faculty, and the resulting barrier prevents corrective encounter.

activation_trace.role: Familiar habitation supplies the socially comfortable enclosure.
Repeated turning supplies the return loop through which the same attitude is reoriented and reinforced.
Entrapment without an exit supplies the accumulating closure generated by repeated conduct.
The inward faculty identifies where the socially reinforced residue settles.
A screening barrier supplies the result: familiarity becomes insulation from correction.

structural_cues: 83:14 places acquired action on hearts and 83:15 immediately follows with exclusion by a barrier; the focus later repeats the same heart/turn root around a familiar destination.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: acquired action, inward faculty, no-exit coating, barrier, and familiar habitation are supplied. Reader arrow: pleased household repetition helps cause or thicken the enclosure. Live alternative: the focus may display a symptom of prior enclosure rather than a cause of it.

changed_reading.before: Home merely provides a safe audience for an already formed attitude.
changed_reading.after: Home is part of the attitude's production: its familiarity turns mockery into a closed loop that settles inwardly and blocks correction.

context_deltas.mechanism: The convivial homecoming prepares a verdict. Within their own circle, the returners convert sight into authoritative speech, classify others as lost, and behave as if qualified and commissioned to supervise them; the following denial of guardianship exposes the household consensus as a counterfeit tribunal.

activation_trace.role: Fitness or qualification supplies the status the household implicitly grants its own speakers.
Banter supplies the informal deliberation from which a solemn-sounding judgment emerges.
Imposing judgment on another supplies the unauthorized adjudicative act.
Departure from guidance supplies the verdict pronounced against the observed group.
Mission and message supply the commission that the next verse explicitly withholds.
Guarding oversight names the office they perform without having received it.

structural_cues: 83:32 immediately externalizes the home mood into a spoken classification, and 83:33 immediately denies that the speakers were sent as guardians.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: household banter, a verdict of error, mission, and guardianship are supplied in sequence. Reader arrow: the home circle converts ridicule into pseudo-authority and ratifies an office its members do not possess. Live alternative: 83:33 may rebut only intrusive observation, not a tribunal-like household process.

changed_reading.before: The household only applauds a joke.
changed_reading.after: The household acts as a counterfeit tribunal, turning amusement into an unauthorized verdict about who is rightly guided.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus is the relay station in an economy of looking and laughter: public amusement passes through covert signaling, is carried home and amplified, then returns as speech when the targets are seen again. The final scene reassigns laughter and looking, so the private homecoming sits at the hinge of a measured reversal rather than as an isolated anecdote.

activation_trace.role: Return and destination make the focus the transfer point between street encounter, home, and renewed encounter.
Displayed delight is the affective token that moves through the sequence and is later reassigned.
Joy or surprise visibly expressed in laughter supplies the public beginning of the circuit.
Passing and proceeding supply the temporal movement from public encounter toward the homeward turn.
Sight by eye and insight restarts the circuit after the private rehearsal.
The same expressed affect is reassigned to the formerly mocked group.
Matching counterpart with counterpart makes the later gaze a calibrated reversal of the earlier one.
Recompense returning to the doer closes the circuit and explains why roles reverse.

structural_cues: 83:29-32 move from laughter to passing signals to homecoming to renewed sight and speech; 83:34-36 repeat laughter and looking with the parties reversed.
The branchless غ م ز occurrence at 83:30 places exchanged covert signals between public laughter and the focus homecoming without supplying a branch ID.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: laughter, passing, covert signaling, homeward return, renewed sight, counter-laughter, matching gaze, and returned recompense are sequentially supplied. Reader arrow: the focus relays and amplifies one social gaze before the sequence returns it to its producers. Live alternative: the later laughter may be simple contrast rather than exact social reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Verse 31 is a detached snapshot of people amused at home.
changed_reading.after: Verse 31 is the hinge where a public gaze is carried into private rehearsal before laughter, looking, and valuation return in reversed ownership.

context_deltas.mechanism: The doubled homeward return becomes a small-scale prefiguration of the closing return of action. They arrive at a chosen destination carrying delight; the ending asks whether the deed itself has come back to its makers as recompense, converting ordinary return into moral recursion.

activation_trace.role: Return together with destination anchors the focus in a completed movement that can be echoed at the ending.
Coming back to a place or state supplies the formal echo of the focus's repeated return.
A deed's consequence returning to its worker supplies the moral direction of the echo.
The enacted work identifies what returns, preventing the echo from remaining merely spatial.

structural_cues: The focus doubles a return verb five verses before the closing interrogative explicitly couples recompense with what they had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two homeward returns and a closing return/recompense of enacted work are supplied. Reader arrow: the local homecoming anticipates a larger recursion in which action finds its way back to the actor. Live alternative: the shared return image may provide closure without making the homecoming itself proleptic.

changed_reading.before: The return ends when they reach home.
changed_reading.after: Their homeward return is nested inside a larger return: the delighted act eventually comes back to its doers as its own recompense.

context_deltas.mechanism: The welcoming ease of home and delighted enjoyment form a counterfeit miniature of the preceding repose and the later couch-bound gaze. Their private circle enthrones itself through ridicule, while the repeated couch-and-looking scene relocates durable ease to the opposite group.

activation_trace.role: Welcome into familiar ease makes the home feel like a self-made zone of security and belonging.
Delighted enjoyment supplies the apparent bliss that the group claims for itself.
Insolent exultation marks that apparent bliss as ethically counterfeit.
Softness and ease of life supply the genuine repose against which the household pleasure is measured.
A couch within an enclosure supplies an enthroned domestic image later repeated after the reversal.
Directed sight relocates the power to observe from the mocking home circle to the opposite party.

structural_cues: Authentic ease, couches, and looking fill 83:22-28 before the ridicule sequence, while 83:35 repeats the couch-and-looking construction after laughter changes sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: genuine ease, enclosed couches, looking, household welcome, and ethically split delight are supplied. Reader arrow: the focus household stages a counterfeit enthronement whose object is ridicule, then the repeated couch scene displaces it. Live alternative: the two comforts may be contrasted without the home scene intentionally parodying the first.

changed_reading.before: Their home is merely the location of their amusement.
changed_reading.after: They use familiar home and in-group delight to stage a counterfeit blessed ease, briefly enthroning themselves before the text relocates repose and the judging gaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses from an adjective of amusement into fruit and consumption imagery. It remains anchored because the focus root itself carries both pleasant produce and the idiom of attacking reputations, while nearby chosen drink and competition sharpen the material analogy. Render it as an exploratory counter-banquet metaphor, not as a claim that فكهين literally means eating people or fruit here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final focus word can hold pleasant produce, delighted talk, and making sport of reputations in one root inventory.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce supplies the edible material image for what the group enjoys at home.
Attacking reputations identifies the figurative substance being consumed.
Actual drinking nearby activates a banquet frame against which verbal consumption can appear counterfeit.
Competing for a prized object supplies the status appetite driving the figurative feast.

changed_reading.before: They enjoy humorous conversation at home.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they make a counter-banquet of absent reputations, consuming social standing as pleasant produce in an in-group status competition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The casting-mold branch is a form-distant nominal image and should not replace the ordinary return sense. It remains worth carrying because the focus repeats the same root around the household and the next verse releases a circulating verdict, giving the image a precise mechanism: home recasts an encounter into a reproducible judgment. Render only as a secondary material analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled ق ل ب root surrounds entry into the household, so a repeated turning-and-recasting image attaches to the verse's own architecture.

activation_trace.role: A casting mold supplies the image of a household form that stamps encounters into a repeatable social product.
Turning and reversing supplies the actual process by which raw encounter is recast.
The bonded household supplies the stable form that repeatedly shapes the group's account.
Speech spreading among people supplies the finished judgment released from the household mold.

changed_reading.before: Home receives an unchanged account of what happened outside.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, home is a mold: it recasts a passing encounter into the standardized, repeatable verdict voiced on the next sighting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Lip inversion is a remote bodily branch and cannot serve as the lexical gloss of انقلبوا. It remains anchored in the repeated focus root and is activated by adjacent visible laughter and subsequent speech, allowing the homecoming to include embodied reenactment of mockery. Downstream prose should mark this as a gestural resonance only.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The repeated turn root can carry a contained bodily echo into the final joking state without displacing the verse's ordinary motion.

activation_trace.role: Lip inversion supplies a mouth-level gesture that can resonate with mocking reenactment.
Joking talk gives the possible lip gesture a conversational setting.
Facial expansion and exposed teeth activate the bodily surface of ridicule before the focus.
Voiced speech after the focus keeps the mouth and its gestures causally connected to the home rehearsal.

changed_reading.before: The doubled turn concerns route and attitude only.
changed_reading.after: As a contained gestural resonance, the returners may also replay the encounter with turned lips and laughing mouths, embodying the mockery they carry home.

strongest_changes: The homecoming becomes the private settlement of an unequal social measure: outsiders are diminished so insiders can collect delight and superiority.
Household banter becomes both a feedback enclosure and a recording process that turns a passing act into durable group identity.
The focus becomes a counterfeit tribunal and the relay point between public laughter, private rehearsal, renewed verdict, and the later counter-gaze.
The doubled return prefigures the closing return of action to its doers, while counterfeit domestic ease is displaced by the opposite group's lasting repose.
summary.what_was_special: The verse's repeated انقلبوا, intimate أهلهم, and unusually branch-rich فكهين make one short homecoming carry spatial return, inward reversal, in-group speech, swagger, reputational consumption, and eventual moral recursion without forcing those readings into a single gloss.
remaining_uncertainties: The second انقلبوا may be resumptive emphasis rather than a distinct inward or qualitative turn.
Measurement, inscription, and enclosure may be thematic analogies around the focus rather than causal descriptions of the household scene.
The fruit, mold, and lip images are anchored but form-distant and should remain explicitly exploratory.
The contrast with genuine ease may frame a deliberate counterfeit paradise, or it may simply juxtapose two opposed outcomes.
